channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 02
item.description:
56 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Projectile age calculations corrected and predicted projectile steps now use the simulation position, fixing inaccurate projectile behavior.
  • Paintball gun now correctly applies selected colour in both first‑person and third‑person views and on overall player models.
  • Grenades and thrown weapons now use Rigidbody information for client‑side prediction before removal, improving throw accuracy.

Combat & Weapons

  • Projectile age calculations corrected and predicted projectile steps now use the simulation position, fixing inaccurate projectile behavior.
  • Paintball gun now correctly applies selected colour in both first‑person and third‑person views and on overall player models.
  • Grenades and thrown weapons now use Rigidbody information for client‑side prediction before removal, improving throw accuracy.

Structures & Deployables

  • Triangle hatch deployment no longer blocked by nearby deployables, improving base building reliability.
  • Monument blockers now have consistent collider states between server and client, preventing mismatched blocking behavior.
  • Barrel blockers retain prevent‑movement colliders across destruction stages, ensuring they stay in place as intended.
  • Shields are no longer compatible with flashlights, preventing unintended illumination effects.

Animals & Ecology

  • Livestock animals no longer cause a null‑reference error when they die, preventing crashes.
  • Introduced an overgrazing system: livestock can deplete grass in an area, halting grazing until the area recovers or a trough is used; overgrazed animals show a label when inspected.

UI & Feedback

  • Toast notifications now correctly parse tokenized phrases and translated toasts, fixing broken on‑screen messages.
  • Contact list notes are now saved and displayed correctly.

Server & Stability

  • Server error "guid is empty" when first dropping certain items has been resolved, allowing items to be placed without crash.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed the oversized visual appearance of the efficiency upgrade, restoring its correct size.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 01
item.description:
74 development commits

Vehicles & Controls

  • Fixed missing colliders on the attack helicopter frame, preventing unintended damage to players.
  • Implemented initial control-set support for cars, boats, helicopters, submarines, horses, and trains, enabling distinct input mappings.
  • Added on-screen toast notifying players that modular cars now have a functional handbrake (max 5 per session).

Environmental Hazards

  • Increased radiation output of sprinkler systems when using radwater: doubled base output plus a 1.5× multiplier.

Clan & Event Mechanics

  • Corrected fuse insertion events for clans so multiple fuses inserted during the same container opening no longer trigger duplicate events.

Gameplay Stability & World Changes

  • Fixed a race condition that could corrupt items in DisplayBoxStorage, ensuring saved items remain consistent.
  • Instantiated PaintballColorLookup early to prevent save-time crashes from multithreaded access.
  • Hardened scope code to stop rare null-reference errors when using a scope.
  • Added monument blockers to red key-card doors in Underwater Labs, altering access routes.

Content Additions & AI

  • Fixed Russian Roulette storage logic (CanAcceptItem), updated prefab and localization, and rebuilt the manifest.
  • Introduced a placeholder milk item.
  • Added a first-pass squirrel interest mechanic, affecting how squirrels react to player actions.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 31
item.description:
47 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Large rig monument blocker collision fixed and missing vent cages added to monuments.
  • Beach area added to water pipe topology, expanding pipe placement options near coastlines.

Base Building

  • Pipe access improved: trees no longer spawn inside pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

Gameplay Bugs

  • Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

Animals & Farming

  • New shearing interaction lets players shear livestock for resources.

Deployables

  • Carvable pumpkin deployment improved for more reliable placement.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Footstep sounds now play correctly when heavily armored or wearing diving fins, restoring audio feedback while moving.

UI & Quality of Life

  • High-Quality Metal collectable now displays its proper name token, fixing missing label issues.
